Messages.Author: William Robert Stone
Messages.Body:
I have just started playing Jyhad and have run across an interesting
question: What is a legal target for the Roschreck?  If I am attempting to use
agrivated hand damage and my opponent manuvers to long range does this still 
count?



			wrstone@eden.rutgers.edu

Messages.Author: Al Orion
Messages.Body:
In article <3cl2es$bs@er7.rutgers.edu>, wrstone@er7.rutgers.edu (William
Robert Stone) writes:

Roschreck is used to send your own vampire into torpor, rather than have
it receive massive aggrivated damage which could send it to final death.
It is a defensive card.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
When a vampire tries to deal aggravated damage to another, Rotschreck
may be used against the vampire *dealing* the aggravated damage.
